answer: Identity bond decay stops bulk fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA bond that loses 5% of its value each epoch unless real work refreshes it, like an ember cooling, its heat a thin plume of smoke. Creating 100 fake identities locks 5,000 POA, and after 20 idle epochs half of it has burned away, so the attacker pays 2,500 POA for nothing. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps it alive by working; hoarding is a bridge too costly to cross.
